messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: metrics.scrape.errors > 1000 (5m) for namespace=prod — auto-page triggered to on-call group. PagerDuty incident: PDINC00012345. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PDINC00012345
PagerDuty: Incident PDINC00012345 triggered by rule 'metrics_scrape_failure_high'. Priority: P1. Affected service: prometheus-scrape. Escalation policy: eng-sre-oncall.
Maya R: acking in PD now. jumping into checks — good to know if this is a single region or global. :eyes:
Sam K (oncall): acked on PD. logging in to do quick sanity checks. which grafana dashboard?
Olivia T: grafana -> Infra / Prometheus / scrape-metrics-overview. I'm seeing a spike in scrape_errors and a drop in 'up' for a subset of targets in us-west-2. Looks like scraping endpoints returning 5xx or connection refused.
Ravi (eng-sre): copying logs from prometheus exporter:```
level=error ts=2024-12-05T14:17:02Z caller=scrape.go:123 target="http://10.10.40.12:9100/metrics" err="dial tcp 10.10.40.12:9100: connect: connection refused"
level=warn ts=2024-12-05T14:17:03Z caller=scrape.go:456 target="http://10.10.40.13:9100/metrics" err="401 unauthorized"
```
Maya R: looks like a mix of network/connectivity and auth failures. Could correlate with last deploy? Any infra changes pushed around 14:10 UTC?
Sam K (oncall): checking deploy history... deploy-bot shows a coincident rollout to node pool 'monitoring-west' at 14:08 UTC. Rollout status: SUCCESS but with one node replaced. Might be transient but number of failing targets is >100 which is abnormal.
Olivia T: also seeing log-ingest lag alerts: log-ingest-lag > 10m for prod-apps-us-west. Some queries for customer metrics are timing out. Could be related if exporters can't connect and logs backlog up.
Ravi (eng-sre): running quick health checks against monitoring nodes:```
# curl -sS -D - http://10.10.40.12:9100/metrics | head -n 5
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/plain; version=0.0.4; charset=utf-8
# HELP node_cpu_seconds_total
# TYPE node_cpu_seconds_total counter
```
Ravi (eng-sre): but that endpoint was flapping earlier. I can see intermittent 500s in the host logs:```
Dec 05 14:16:58 host-40 kernel: network_interface eth0 down
Dec 05 14:17:01 host-40 systemd: prometheus-node-exporter.service: Failed with result 'exit-code'
```
Maya R: hypothesis: maintenance/rolling restart on monitoring node pool caused exporters to bounce and left Prometheus with temporary target churn -> scrape errors + log backlog. Customer impact: some dashboards will show gaps; alerting for derived metrics may miss. We should confirm whether any customer-facing rate limits or requests failed.
Sam K (oncall): I'm going to temporarily silence the high-volume scrape_errors alert to reduce noise while we triage (silence 1h). Also contacting infra to see if node pool had a forced restart.
PagerDuty: Note: PDINC00012345 acknowledged by Sam K (oncall). Next escalation in 15m if not resolved.
Infra-run: infra confirmed a control-plane maintenance job kicked at 14:07 UTC, it restarted 3 nodes in monitoring-west due to kernel patch. It should have drained, but one node failed graceful drain and pods evicted abruptly. Ops: creating a rollback to previous node image and re-provisioning.
Olivia T: mitigation plan: 1) silence noisy alerts 2) add temporary rule to exclude monitoring-west targets from alert threshold while infra fixes nodes 3) re-scrape backlog: bump scrape timeout? Not ideal.
Ravi (eng-sre): applying temporary silence and tag-based filter now. Also enabling 'fallback' job pointing to exporter replicas in monitoring-east as a short-term measure.
Maya R: customer impact note for status page: "Prometheus scraping errors in us-west affected monitoring metrics and dashboards. No direct user-facing API failures observed, but metrics/dashboards may be delayed or incomplete. Engineers are mitigating." I'll draft a status page blurb after we confirm.
Sam K (oncall): infra replaced the failed node, exporters are coming back. 'up' count recovering from 72 -> 310 targets. Scrape_errors rate dropping back to baseline.
Ravi (eng-sre): confirming log-ingest-lag decreasing. Requeued backlog drain in progress.
incident-bot: Incident PDINC00012345: status changed to RESOLVED by Sam K (oncall). Resolution summary: transient node restarts in monitoring-west caused exporter flapping -> Prometheus scrape errors and downstream log backlog. Mitigations applied: silence, target filter, fallback exporters, infra node reprovision.
Maya R: adding handoff notes for next oncall: watch for regressions for next 2 hours, check log-ingest-lag and scrape_errors panels. I'll follow up with infra root-cause.
Olivia T: quick retro items: add a pre-rollout playbook for monitoring node kernel updates, ensure graceful draining checks, and add more exporter redundancy across regions.
Sam K (oncall): thanks team. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
